disclosures: Cell coordinates of the forges were read with a read-only zone probe after arrival; the forges themselves were then found on screen and used through the ordinary interact menu. No forge verb was run (the fresh character carries no heads, hafts or bindings); the forge verbs are shared, unchanged code exercised by Sill and Cinderhold and by existing tests.
The forge draws as the existing red glyph with its existing native icon in readers; no new art, no presentation admission for these zones.
Only seed-dependent placement for one fresh world was played; 24-seed sweeps and three named seeds are native tests.
Not exercised: Mac package at this source, Linux/Deck, a relapse in a live session (native test only).
